checks: encrypted round trip preserves full draft, PDF, Unicode and unfinished fields
every save rotates the opaque key, IV and authenticated envelope ID
exact guest, account and workspace scopes remain isolated
metadata and ciphertext tampering fail closed without replacing the saved row
copying a row to another account or changing its plaintext owner cannot expose that owner's profile
future envelope versions are preserved, exportable and blocked until explicit reset
unknown future profile fields cannot be silently stripped on load or save
optional job fields receive safe defaults while known draft data remains intact
bad UTF-8, malformed JSON and duplicate canonical jobs preserve the original ciphertext
malformed present rows are not mistaken for an empty workspace
a new tab must load an existing draft before it can replace it
cross-tab changes are rejected and export does not adopt another tab's version
compare-and-set closes the race between the initial read and final encrypted commit
same-tab saves remain ordered and capture values before their queue starts
a reset cancels older queued saves and leaves no resurrected draft
deletion in another tab cannot be silently undone by an older draft
an empty-to-saved-to-reset change cannot bypass another tab's expected revision
quota failure keeps the prior ciphertext and allows a later explicit retry
read and delete failures never report an empty or successfully removed draft
exporting a repaired row does not clear a previous safety block
valid exports are readable snapshots and do not mutate stored data
metadata listing isolates exact accounts and never exposes encrypted content or keys
malformed and ambiguous scope identifiers never reach storage
invalid or oversized new fields do not replace the last valid draft
maximum collection counts, full Unicode notes and a 5 MB PDF survive a bounded round trip
an unfamiliar IndexedDB version surfaces a recovery-safe error without deleting databases
missing browser capabilities fail explicitly while module import remains SSR-safe
coverage: Actual Node WebCrypto + structured-cloned non-extractable keys; injected atomic storage port. Real browser IndexedDB acceptance remains a separate check.
